title: Fix Names
description: This is a Resource Pack designed to restore some Old Names.
body: Fix names Resorce Pack is an attempt to bring back some old names of blocks and rename blocks to **what everyone actually calles them.** I.E: "~~Daylight Detector~~" --> "Daylight Sensor" **Please let me know if you want any block names updated.** https://youtu.be/ZObPdqJCZos
